dialogues.speaker: Sasani
dialogues.text: Yes, the one who designed this masterpiece is my senior.

dialogues.speaker: Sasani
dialogues.text: But it is a pity that Mr. Kaveh graduated before I was even admitted.

dialogues.speaker: Sasani
dialogues.text: So, I didn't have the honor to speak with him in person, and I've never even attended a single architectural elective taught by him.

dialogues.speaker: Sasani
dialogues.text: Hmm... Mr. Kaveh is so great. I'm sure he has gained both fame and fortune, holding an important position somewhere in the world...
